regression_proof.polling_backoff: Removing only the post-recovery reset fails with 59 ms outside the required 10–20 ms range.
regression_proof.terminal_trust: Ten real TLS/control cases require no requests to a secondary endpoint, including malformed Close denial.

limitations: A concurrent native run passed 199/203; four failures involved a 45-second fixture guard, request timeouts and a classic Raft receive error. Their isolated reruns pass; the concurrency failures remain unclassified.

An earlier concurrent TSan run passed 17/18; its hostname-denial actor exceeded a ten-second fixture wait. The unchanged trust fixture and complete isolated TSan matrix pass; this does not attribute that timeout.
Local processes and two VMs do not qualify independent failure domains or fleet capacity.
